title: Offline Image Inventory Desk — Local Image Header Catalog
customer_problem: People organizing personal image folders need to inspect formats and dimensions without uploading photos or opening every file in a full image editor.
audience: Windows users handling small collections of PNG, JPEG, GIF and BMP images who want a private bilingual inventory and a portable CSV summary.
differentiation: Read-only bounded image-header inspection with zero external dependencies, local CSV export and recoverable JSON sessions; no EXIF harvesting or image editing.
scope: Inspect PNG, JPEG, GIF and BMP image headers locally without decoding pixels or modifying source images.
Show bounded dimensions, format and byte size for up to 200 user-selected images with per-file errors.
Provide a bilingual 1024x768 desktop table with a clear first-run action and empty state.
Save and reopen local JSON sessions atomically with backup recovery for malformed sessions.
Export a CSV inventory safely with overwrite confirmation and original-file overwrite prevention.
Run headless functional tests for image formats, corrupt headers, symlinks, limits, recovery and CSV export.
research_note: Public issues are weak untrusted signals. Original stdlib-only implementation, cohort 5/5.
